thread:
leo_ae: Heads up — Marigold wants to run a POC with their 13B quantized variant. Key asks: VPC+B YOK during trial, HSM for private later, p95 <20ms for 16-token responses, and an enterprise pricing ballpark. Can we do a compatibility probe this week?
emily_sales: They’ll start hosted for speed but plan on private later. Main blockers: security questionnaire (HSM attestation) and pricing approval for reserved nodes.
kai_ml: Quick question: is the variant using standard attention/MLP + RMSNorm? Any custom ops or activation fns beyond the reported custom GELU?
leo_ae: They sent an artifact URL and wrote "llama-compat, 8-bit quant, custom GELU". Attached a one-line manifest.
jordan_sre: @kai_ml FYI custom GELU may require a custom CUDA kernel or fallback to a slower path — could impact 95th percentile latency. Also need KV cache layout details; our continuous-batching path assumes standard KV ordering.
kai_ml: To validate I'll need either TorchScript or ONNX and the tokenizer files plus a small sample trace. If we can run a quick perf on a dev node we can confirm p95.
emily_sales: I'll request the artifact + minimal runbook and a short golden prompt set. They also asked for an SLA clause that allows automatic failover to a smaller variant if latency degrades. Is that supported?
nora_ops: Failover is supported via routing policies but we need the fallback variant pre-registered in the catalog and approved by security. Autoscaling on Dedicated pools required to maintain p95 under load.
marta_security: HSM/KMS note: Private/on-prem supports direct HSM integration. Hosted can do BYOK via a KMS proxy with attestation — that increases onboarding complexity. We need their key rotation policy and data-at-rest retention answers.
leo_ae: Legal also requested SOC2 and a penetration-test summary. Can we provide redacted reports under NDA?
marta_security: Yes, we have a SOC2 package and pentest executive summary available under NDA. I'll spin up the NDA doc and checklist.
pricebot: Rough capacity estimate: reserved 4xA100-equivalent with 99th p95 SLA => $XX,XXX/mo. Hosted trial pricing differs; need model size and batch profile to firm it up.
emily_sales: If they commit to a 2-month trial and reserve minimal capacity can we give a tighter quote?
pricebot: If they commit to 2xA100-equivalent with pre-warming and warm KV shards, estimate $YY,YYY/mo pro forma. Will attach per-token delta after size is known.
kai_ml: To run the compatibility sweep I need: model artifact, tokenizer vocab/merges, 50-sample prompt set, and a ~1 minute raw trace showing KV cache behavior and a single-utterance latency log.
leo_ae: I'll collect those and push today. Anything else blocking onboarding the variant into the catalog?
nora_ops: Two gating items: security sign-off (Marta) and a quantization profile validation (Kai). Also require a unique build id for the variant and enable canary routing for the trial.
jordan_sre: Suggested runtime defaults: batch interval 8ms, max_batch_tokens=2048 to start. If custom GELU slows kernels we'll fallback to a smaller variant or CPU-optimized kernel.
kai_ml: If they provide TorchScript we can compile and run kernel selection. If only ggml/flatbuffers we'll run a quant profile; note custom GELU can add ~10-15% instruction count -> latency hit.
marta_security: Also need their DFD (data flow diagram) and list of third-party vendors for the security questionnaire.
leo_ae: I'll request DFD + vendor list. They also asked whether BYOK is supported during the hosted trial.
marta_security: BYOK for hosted requires KMS proxy + attestation and limited key lifetimes for trial. I'll specify exact requirements in the checklist.
emily_sales: Proposed timeline: Leo requests artifacts today; Kai performs perf runs by Friday; Marta issues NDA + security checklist; Nora scopes Dedicated pool and generates a draft capacity quote; I’ll prepare a trial contract.
pricebot: Once we have model size and batch profile I can produce a formal quote and per-token estimates.
leo_ae: Perfect — I’ll post artifacts here as soon as I have them.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create ticket INF-4721 to track Marigold POC onboarding steps.
